long_biography.plain_text:
Gilbert Torelli rose through Moulinex in sales, marketing and distribution, working across France and international markets. He joined the management group assembled to prepare for founder Jean Mantelet's succession, then served as director general and president of the supervisory board.

The employee-and-management buyout gave Torelli a personal equity position. Contemporary reporting said his two-million-franc investment was worth almost 28 million francs when the structure was unwound. He also managed Finamex during a recapitalisation that placed it alongside Euris in Moulinex's control holding. His later roles included leadership at Konica France and a seat on Rallye's board.
